common_name: Sea Glass Heuchera (Minty-Lime Rounded-Leaf Coral Bells)

planting.note: Plant divisions or container-grown starts in spring or early fall in well-drained, humus-rich soil; Sea Glass is a Terra Nova Nurseries introduction that tolerates more sun than most Heuchera. Give it full sun to part shade with consistent moisture for the brightest foliage color.

directions: Plant Sea Glass in well-drained, humus-rich soil in full sun to part shade; it forms a tidy mound of rounded, scalloped minty-lime leaves that hold their color better in brighter light than most coral bells. Slender stems carry small white flowers well above the foliage in late spring and early summer. Divide congested clumps every 3-4 years in spring to maintain vigor and leaf color.
